en: If I had more time, I would research new markets.
tr: Daha fazla vaktim olsaydı, yeni pazarları araştırırdım.
ipa: /ɪf aɪ hæd mɔː taɪm aɪ wʊd rɪˈsɜːtʃ njuː ˈmɑːkɪts/
trPron: if ay hed mor taym ay vud risörç nyu markits
tense: Second conditional, gerçekleşmesi zor veya hayali durumlar için If kısmında Past Simple, ana cümlede 'would' kullanır.
commonMistake: If I would have more time, I would research... ❌

en: If the machine worked, we would finish the order.
ipa: /ɪf ðə məˈʃiːn wɜːkt wiː wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ði ˈɔːdə/
trPron: if dı maşiyn vörkt vi vud finiş di ordır
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If the machine would work, we would finish... ❌
aiExplain: Mevcut bir sorunu hayali olarak çözme senaryosunda Second Conditional yapısı kullanılır.

en: If we had extra staff, we would complete the project today.
tr: Ekstra personelimiz olsaydı, projeyi bugün tamamlardık.
ipa: /ɪf wiː hæd ˈɛkstrə stɑːf wiː wʊd kəmˈpliːt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt təˈdeɪ/
trPron: if vi hev ekstrı staf vi vud kompliyt dı projekt tımdey
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If we would have extra staff, we would... ❌
aiExplain: Kaynak kısıtı olan bir projede hayali bir kapasite artışını Second Conditional ile ifade ederiz.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If I had checked the data, I would not have made a mistake.
ipa: /ɪf aɪ hæd tʃɛkt ðə ˈdeɪtə aɪ wʊd nɒt hæv meɪd ə mɪsˈteɪk/
trPron: if ay hed çekt dı deytı ay vud not hev meyd e misteyk
tense: Third conditional, geçmişte yaşanmış olaylara dair pişmanlık veya hayali durumları (Past Perfect + Would have V3) anlatır.
commonMistake: If I would have checked the data, I wouldn't have made a mistake. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the shipment had arrived on time, we would have met the deadline.
tr: Sevkiyat zamanında gelseydi, teslim tarihini yakalardık.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈʃɪpmənt hæd əˈraɪvd ɒn taɪm wiː wʊd hæv mɛt ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
trPron: if dı şipmınt hed erayvd on taym vi vud hev met dı dedlayn
tense: Third Conditional
commonMistake: If the shipment would have arrived... ❌
aiExplain: Geçmişte yaşanmış bir sevkiyat gecikmesinin telafisi olmayan sonucunu Third Conditional ile belirtiriz.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the directors had approved the budget, the project would have succeeded.
tr: Direktörler bütçeyi onaylasalardı, proje başarılı olurdu.
ipa: /ɪf ðə daɪˈrɛktəz hæd əˈpruːvd ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt wʊd hæv səkˈsiːdɪd/
trPron: if dı direktırz hed epruuvd dı bacit dı projekt vud hev sıksiydid
tense: Third Conditional
commonMistake: If the directors would have approved the budget... ❌
aiExplain: Geçmişteki bir kararın (bütçe onayı) olası alternatif sonucunu Third Conditional kurgular.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If they had updated the firewall, they would not have had the breach.
ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ hæd ʌpˈdeɪtɪd ðə ˈfaɪəwɔːl ðeɪ wʊd nɒt hæv hæd ðə briːtʃ/
trPron: if dey hed apdeytid dı fayırvol dey vud not hev hed dı briyç
tense: Third Conditional
collocations: had updated, would not have had
commonMistake: If they would have updated the firewall... ❌
aiExplain: Geçmişte önlenebilir bir güvenlik ihlalini Third Conditional yapısı ile analiz ederiz.

en: If we offered a discount, the client would sign today.
ipa: /ɪf wiː ˈɒfəd ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ðə ˈklaɪənt wʊd saɪn təˈdeɪ/
trPron: if vi ofırd e diskaunt dı klayınt vud sayn tımdey
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If we would offer a discount, the client would sign... ❌
aiExplain: Bugün (şu an) gerçekleşmesi olası bir ticari senaryoyu Second Conditional ile kurgularız.

en: If the office were in the city center, the staff would be happier.
tr: Ofis şehir merkezinde olsaydı, personel daha mutlu olurdu.
ipa: /ɪf ði ˈɒfɪs wɜːr ɪn ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər ðə stɑːf wʊd biː ˈhæpiər/
trPron: if di ofis vör in dı siti sentır dı staf vud bi hepiyır
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If the office was in the city center... (Acceptable but were is preferred) ❌
aiExplain: 'If I/he/she/it were' kullanımı Second Conditional'da yaygındır ve mevcut konumun hayali alternatifini belirtir.

en: If I were the manager, I would hire more people.
tr: Müdür olsaydım, daha fazla insan işe alırdım.
ipa: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˈmænɪdʒə aɪ wʊd ˈhaɪər mɔː ˈpiːpl/
trPron: if ay vör dı menicır ay vud hayır mor piypıl
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If I was the manager... (Common, but were is formal standard) ❌
aiExplain: Müdürlük pozisyonunun hayali alternatifi 'If I were' kalıbı ile Second Conditional'da kurulur.

en: If we had the budget, we would approve it.
ipa: /ɪf wiː hæd ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt wiː wʊd əˈpruːv ɪt/
trPron: if vi hed dı bacit vi vud epruuv it
tense: Second conditional kuralı: 'If' yan cümlesi Past Simple, ana cümle 'would' ile kurulur. 'If' yan cümlesinde 'would' yasaktır.
commonMistake: If we would have the budget, we would approve it. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: had known, would have finished
ipa: had I known
trPron: None
tense: Third conditional kuralı: 'If' yan cümlesi Past Perfect (had + V3), ana cümle 'would have + V3' olmalıdır. 'Would have' If'li kısma gelemez.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If they had checked the engine, the plane would not have crashed.
ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ hæd tʃɛkt ði ˈɛndʒɪn ðə pleɪn wʊd nɒt hæv kræʃt/
trPron: if dey hed çekt di encin dı pleyn vud not hev kireşt
tense: Geçmişte yaşanmış bir felaketin kurgusal analizi (Third Conditional) If + Past Perfect + Would have V3 ile kurulur.
commonMistake: If they would have checked the engine, the plane would... ❌

en: If the system worked, we would avoid the error.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈsɪstəm wɜːkt wiː wʊd əˈvɔɪd ðə ˈɛrə/
trPron: if dı sistım vörkt vi vud evoyd dı erır
tense: 'If' yan cümlesinde 'would' kullanılması Second Conditional kuralına aykırıdır. 'Worked' (Past Simple) doğrudur.
commonMistake: If the system would work, we would avoid the error. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If I had seen the email, I would have replied.
ipa: /ɪf aɪ hæd siːn ði ˈiːmeɪl aɪ wʊd hæv rɪˈplaɪd/
trPron: if ay hed siin di iimeyl ay vud hev riplayd
tense: Third conditional kuralı, If yan cümlesinde 'would' kullanımını yasaklar. 'Had seen' (Past Perfect) kuraldır.
commonMistake: If I would have seen the email, I would have replied. ❌

en: If we had more money, we would start the project.
tr: Daha fazla paramız olsaydı, projeye başlardık.
ipa: /ɪf wiː hæd mɔː ˈmʌni wiː wʊd stɑːt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/
trPron: if vi hed mor mani vi vud sıtart dı projekt
tense: İkinci tip şartlı cümlede 'If' yan cümlesinde 'would' kullanımı dilbilgisi hatasıdır. 'Had' (Past Simple) zorunludur.
commonMistake: If we would have more money, we would start the project. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If they had verified the logs, they would not have crashed.
ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ hæd ˈvɛrɪfaɪd ðə lɒɡz ðeɪ wʊd nɒt hæv kræʃt/
trPron: if dey hed verifayd dı logz dey vud not hev kireşt
tense: Third conditional, If cümlesinde 'would' almaz. 'Had verified' (Past Perfect) geçmiş kesinlik içindir.
collocations: IT server system logs screen terminal
commonMistake: If they would have verified the logs, they would... ❌

en: If the courier were faster, delivery would be early.
tr: Kurye daha hızlı olsaydı, teslimat erken olurdu.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈkʊərɪər wɜːr ˈfɑːstər ðə dɪˈlɪvəri wʊd biː ˈɜːli/
trPron: if dı kuriyır vör fastır dı dilivıri vud bi örli
tense: İkinci tip şartlı cümlede 'If' yan cümlesinde 'would' yasaktır. 'Were' (Past Simple) kuraldır.
commonMistake: If the courier would be faster, delivery would be early. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If they had planned better, we would have avoided losses.
ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ hæd plænd ˈbɛtər wiː wʊd hæv əˈvɔɪdɪd ˈlɒsɪz/
trPron: if dey hed plend betır vi vud hev evoydid losiz
tense: Third conditional, If kısmında 'would' almaz. 'Had planned' (Past Perfect) geçmişe ait kuraldır.
commonMistake: If they would have planned better, we would have avoided... ❌

en: If we invested in tech, we would save money.
tr: Teknolojiye yatırım yapsaydık, para tasarrufu sağlardık.
ipa: /ɪf wiː ɪnˈvɛstɪd ɪn tɛk wiː wʊd seɪv ˈmʌni/
trPron: if vi investid in tek vi vud seyv mani
tense: İkinci tip şartlı cümle kuralı gereği 'If' kısmında 'would' yasaktır. 'Invested' (Past Simple) doğrudur.
commonMistake: If we would invest in tech, we would save money. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If I had asked, you would have helped me.
ipa: /ɪf aɪ hæd ɑːskt juː wʊd hæv hɛlpt miː/
trPron: if ay hed askt yu vud hev helpt mi
tense: Third conditional'da If yan cümlesi 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) olmalıdır. 'Would' ana cümleye aittir.
commonMistake: If I would have asked, you would have helped me. ❌

en: If the team were faster, we would finish early.
tr: Ekip daha hızlı olsaydı, erken bitirirdik.
ipa: /ɪf ðə tiːm wɜːr ˈfɑːstər wiː wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈɜːli/
trPron: if dı tiym vör fastır vi vud finiş örli
tense: Second conditional kuralı, If yan cümlesinde 'would' kullanımını yasaklar. 'Were' (Past Simple) kuraldır.
commonMistake: If the team would be faster, we would finish early. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the process had run well, we would have saved time.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈprəʊsɛs hæd rʌn wɛl wiː wʊd hæv seɪvd taɪm/
trPron: if dı pıroses hed ran vel vi vud hev seyvd taym
tense: Third conditional, 'If' + Past Perfect + Would have V3 kuralı ile geçmişteki verimlilik kayıplarını analiz eder.
commonMistake: If the process would have run well, we would have saved time. ❌

en: If we found the bug, we would fix it today.
ipa: /ɪf wiː faʊnd ðə bʌɡ wiː wʊd fɪks ɪt təˈdeɪ/
trPron: if vi faund dı bag vi vud fiks it tımdey
tense: İkinci tip şartlı cümlede 'If' kısmında 'would' kullanımı dilbilgisi hatasıdır. 'Found' (Past Simple) doğrudur.
collocations: IT terminal code bug fix screen
commonMistake: If we would find the bug, we would fix it today. ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If they had signed, we would have had high profit.
ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ hæd saɪnd wiː wʊd hæv hæd haɪ ˈprɒfɪt/
trPron: if dey hed saynd vi vud hev hed hay pırofit
tense: Third conditional kuralı, 'If' yan cümlesinde 'would' kullanımını yasaklar. 'Had signed' (Past Perfect) kuraldır.
collocations: sales deal signing contract profit chart
commonMistake: If they would have signed, we would have had high profit. ❌
